global_rules: patient/study is the minimum split unit
no slices from one study may appear in more than one split
test sets are never used for checkpoint selection
test sets are never used for temperature scaling
test sets are never used for confidence-threshold selection
exact manifests must be hashed and frozen before model training

covid_ct_md.exact_counts: generated after identity inventory; no patient is dropped to force aesthetically convenient class counts

covid19_ct_seg_20.metric_rule: Every volume receives predictions only from a model whose training set excluded that volume.
covid19_ct_seg_20.quantification_rule: Left/right/total involvement statistics are calculated only from strict out-of-fold predictions.

cc_ccii_lesion_subset.preferred_rule: Use documented official study-disjoint train/validation/test partition if the distributed identifiers reproduce it exactly.
cc_ccii_lesion_subset.fallback_rule: If official manifests are unavailable but stable study IDs exist, freeze deterministic study-level 80/10/10 split using seed 1705 before training.
